Responsibilities
Position Overview IDEMIA's Justice & Public Safety division develops biometric identification platforms used by law enforcement agencies across North America. Our systems process fingerprint, facial recognition, and criminal history data in support of active investigations, which requires that security be embedded throughout our engineering practices rather than addressed at the end of the development cycle.
We are seeking a Senior Application Security Engineer to define and own our holistic approach to application security across the full software development lifecycle. You will establish the security controls that govern our engineering practices, guide multiple teams across three product lines in their implementation, and remain directly involved in hands-on execution. This is a senior individual contributor position with significant organizational influence and no direct reports.
Key Responsibilities
Define and own the holistic approach to security
Establish security controls and validation gates for each lifecycle stage: design, code, build, deploy, software customization and delivery, and operations
Develop the standards, guardrails, and documentation guiding multiple engineering teams across three product lines
Partner with our internal shared security services team, which conducts penetration testing and SAST/SCA scanning, to triage findings, assess severity, and set remediation priorities
Execute hands-on security work
Conduct architecture and design reviews to identify security risk, and collaborate with engineering teams on remediation
Develop and enhance security stages within our CI/CD pipelines
Participate in incident response and triage activities
Support compliance and customer engagement
Maintain our FedRAMP and CJIS compliance posture as it pertains to application security
Represent our security approach in customer engagements, audits, and technical reviews
Technical Environment
Languages and runtimes: Java, TypeScript, AWS Lambda
Cloud platforms: AWS GovCloud, Azure Government
CI/CD: GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins
Security tooling: SonarQube, Nexus, Tenable
Performance Expectations
First 90 days — Document the current lifecycle and tooling landscape, publish a defined set of security controls organized by lifecycle stage, establish a triage cadence with the shared security services team, and deliver at least one measurable improvement to pipeline security posture.
First year — Security controls applied consistently across all product lines, findings remediated on a predictable schedule, and engineering teams engaging security during design rather than at review.
Scope of AuthorityWhere a release does not meet established security criteria, you will raise the concern and escalate to the Vice President of Engineering for final determination. Your technical judgment will drive these discussions, supported by executive sponsorship.
The US base salary range for this position is $112,130.00 - 140,171.00 + bonus + benefits. While it is uncommon for candidates to be hired at or near the top of the pay range, all compensation decisions are made based on the specific facts and circumstances of each hire. The final offer may vary depending on a combination of factors, including a candidate’s skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
Minimum 10 years of combined software engineering and security experience, including substantive time in a DevSecOps capacity
Demonstrated experience embedding security controls directly into CI/CD pipelines
Proven ability to conduct security reviews of application and cloud architectures
Practical experience triaging SAST, SCA, and penetration test findings, including distinguishing material risk from false positives
Working knowledge of cloud security in AWS and/or Azure, preferably government cloud environments
Ability to obtain and maintain background clearances from local, state, and federal agencies
Availability to travel approximately 10% of the time
Candidates must be a U.S. Person (U.S. citizen, Green Card holder, or otherwise authorized under applicable U.S. regulations) to be considered for this position.
Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with FedRAMP, CJIS, NIST 800-53, or comparable frameworks
Certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GWAPT, or OSCP
Experience in biometrics, identity management, or public safety software
Threat modeling experience (STRIDE, PASTA, or comparable)
Secrets management and software supply chain security, including SBOM generation

About the Role The Product Solution Architect will provide strategic leadership for the end-to-end Quote-to-Cash business process, including Salesforce CPQ, CLM, and connected enterprise applications. This role will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Finance, Operations, CX, Partners and implementation teams to design solutions that improve how business configure products, price and quote accurately, generate compliant contracts, manage approvals, and accelerate deal execution. It will be key to understand business priorities, identify process improvement opportunities, and evaluate solution options that optimize business outcomes. Job Duties: Translate business strategy into scalable solutions. Partner with the Director, CPQ & CLM, product leaders, and business stakeholders to convert strategic priorities into actionable architecture, capability roadmaps, process designs, and platform solutions. Serve as the senior technical and functional advisor. Provide expert guidance on CPQ and CLM platform capabilities, configuration options, customization tradeoffs, integration approaches, data model decisions, automation opportunities, and long-term scalability. Shape the responsible adoption of AI-enabled capabilities within the Quote-to-Cash process, such as pricing and deal guidance, workflow automation, and contract intelligence. Ensure AI solutions are practical, secure, governed appropriately, and grounded in reliable business and data processes. By combining business process leadership with architectural oversight, enable the organization to scale CPQ, CLM, and AI capabilities. Drive quote-to-contract process optimization. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, improve approval efficiency, increase quote accuracy, accelerate contract cycle times, and improve the customer and internal user experience. Lead cross-functional solution alignment. Facilitate design discussions with Sales, Deal Desk, Revenue Operations, Legal Operations, Finance, Product, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and Enterprise Architecture to align on requirements, dependencies, risks, and implementation options. Create reusable design patterns, documentation standards, decision frameworks, and best practices that support long-term maintainability and product scalability. Provide subject matter expertise. Serve as a trusted advisor on CPQ and CLM platform capabilities, configuration tradeoffs, system limitations, data dependencies, automation opportunities, and implementation risks.
